hook_text: This child has a big round belly. So why is the nurse worried that she is not getting enough food?
clip_script: A clinic nurse visits a class in Upington. Poster one: a swollen belly from too little protein. Kwashiorkor. Poster two: a child too thin, from too little food. Marasmus. No vitamin C? Bleeding gums: scurvy. No iron? Pale and tired: anaemia. And too much? Sugar rots teeth, salt raises blood pressure, and too much energy food leads to obesity and diabetes. Balance keeps us well.
visual_style: Whiteboard posters flipping one by one, each with a missing or extra nutrient and the disease it causes.
pacing: Too little first, then missing vitamins, then too much, then the fix.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and check that your meals have vegetables and protein.
